sources.publisher: New York State Department of Financial Services
sources.version: Second Amendment, effective 1 Nov. 2023; all transitional periods expired (s 500.22(d)(2) 1 Nov. 2024, s 500.22(d)(4) 1 Nov. 2025)
sources.intervalBecause: s 500.19 read in full against the DFS official adoption text on 2026-08-09 (rf_fs_2amend23NYCRR500_text_20231101.pdf), cross-read against the DFS consolidated copy, which agrees word for word and carries its own notice that it is not an official version. The limb-to-section mapping is what three shipped receipts now depend on, and s 500.19(a) already lost s 500.12 once by amendment - so a change here silently makes a customer-facing receipt wrong rather than merely stale.

sources.label: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
sources.whyUnverified: This row asserts what ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Cl. 6.1.3 and 8.3 REQUIRE — a claim about the standard's text, not just its numbering. ISO text is paywalled, iso.org's Online Browsing Platform returns HTTP 403 here, and the maintainer confirmed on 2026-08-08 that this project holds no ISO licence. This is permanent, not pending: do not re-attempt from the web. Two ways to close it — read a licensed copy, or narrow the claim in references/exceptions.md to the clause numbering alone, which the nist-csf crosswalk already verifies via NIST's own reference export.
